current_interpretation: The draft refuses to treat NODI codes as self-explaining. Rows without a numeric DMR_VALUE_NMBR in FY2025 are collected in no_numeric_result_case with the raw NODI_CODE preserved. The nodi_code_semantics requirement lists only the empty string as known; all nonempty codes (C on 150 rows, 9 on 36 rows) remain uninterpreted. The draft does not assign meanings such as 'no discharge' or 'not required' to either code.
why_it_matters: Purpose C asks what missing-evidence cases establish—documented no-discharge, conditional monitoring not required, other no-data states, or inadequate evidence for required monitoring. Without interpreting NODI codes, 186 FY2025 no-result cases cannot be classified and must stay unresolved rather than being treated as compliance or violation by default.
